html.body: Date: 2025-03-28 REMARKSThis is responsive to the Final Office Action mailed on January 29, 2025. With this response, claims 1, 8 and 9 are amended and claims 5 and 6 are cancelled. This application continues with claims 1-4 and 7-13. Reconsideration and allowance of all of the claims is respectfully requested.The Applicant thanks the Examiner for the indication of allowance of the subject matter of claims 6, 9 and 10-13. Claim 1 has been amended to include the subject matter of allowable claim 6 including intervening claim 5. Claims 5 and 6 have thus been cancelled. As claim 1 has been amended to include the subject matter indicated as allowable, it is believed that all of the pending claims currently in the application are in condition for allowance.I. CLAIM REJECTIONS - 35 USC X112 Claims 5-6 and 8-9 are rejected as being indefinite. Applicant respectfully disagrees with this contention.Claims 5 and 6 have been incorporated into claim 1 and claim 1 amended to refer to the roll and pitch axes for clarity and claims 8 and 9 amended to correct dependency to claim 1. It is respectfully submitted the claims are definite. It is respectfully requested this rejection be withdrawn and the claims allowed.II. CLAIM REJECTIONS - 35 USC X102 Claims 1-4 and 7 are rejected as being anticipated by US4283152, hereinafter "Smith." Applicant respectfully disagrees with this contention. However, claim 1 has been amended to include the subject matter of original claims 5 and 6. Smith does not teach each and every element of the currently amended claims. It is respectfully requested this rejection be withdrawn and the claims allowed.III. CLAIM REJECTIONS - 35 USC X103 Claims 5 and 8 are rejected as being unpatentable over Smith. Applicant respectfully disagrees with this contention for at least the same reasons as set forth above in distinguishing claim 1 over the disclosure of Smith. It is respectfully requested this rejection be withdrawn and the claims allowed.It is respectfully submitted that the claims are neither met nor made obvious by the cited combination.Reconsideration and allowance of all of the claims is respectfully requested.The Director is authorized to charge any fee deficiency required by this paper or credit any overpayment to Deposit Account No. 23-1123.Respectfully submitted, WESTMAN, CHAMPLIN & KOEHLER, P.A.By: /Amanda M.
